name: Mitarai Yuuna
source: Another girl employed as a servant in similar fashion as Yukito. In need of money for her younger brother's operation, Mitarai has no choice but to work in this job as a servant. Together, will they be able to endure the Mamiyas and find the correct way to escape?
translation: Another girl employed as a servant in similar fashion as Yukito. In need of money for her younger brother's operation, Mitarai has no choice but to work in this job as a servant. Together, will they be able to endure the Mamiyas and find the correct way to escape?
